notes: Sycamore on the west, Broadway (100', faces x 2556 and 2902) on the east, E. 2nd at the top. Yeatman (24'9") runs from Sycamore to Broadway and ends at both (it continues west of Sycamore on sheet 103). Spencer Alley (printed SPENCER, about 9-10 ft, no width printed) runs north from Yeatman across E. 2nd (continuing north onto sheet 114); south of Yeatman it does not continue. South of the Yeatman block E. Front has a drawn north face only (y about 2189; the Public Landing lies to the south, with railroad tracks at y about 2340): its centre is taken as the north face plus half of 66 ft, which falls on the 10" water pipe (y about 2305). E. Front changes direction at Broadway: west of it it runs nearly E-W, east of it it runs ENE (about 29 degrees) toward Ludlow, so the Broadway/Front point is also the bend. Giffin (40 ft between faces, slanting ENE at about 20 degrees) enters from the east and ends at Broadway; its centreline is extended to Broadway's centre. The unnamed passage at y 1373 (about 12 ft, 3" W.P.) runs east from Broadway to the edge of the drawn area; on sheet 105 it continues as the unnamed alley to Ludlow. The 100' figure printed in Broadway near Front is the street width.
